def: One of six grounds in Article 6(1) of the GDPR that make processing personal data lawful: consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task or legitimate interests.
practice: Training, fine-tuning or building eval sets on personal data each needs one, documented per purpose; the EDPB's Opinion 28/2024 (December 2024) addresses when legitimate interest can cover developing and deploying AI models.
